title: FitFight Specials v2 roster

series.name: Night Hunters
series.blurb: Dark, dangerous, metallic. The ones you do not want in your fight.

specials.name: Black Panther
specials.outfit: black sleeveless compression top, black tapered joggers, black high-tops with gold trim
specials.accessory: thick gold rope chain, small gold hoop earring
specials.attitude: arms crossed, narrowed gold eyes, quiet dangerous smirk
specials.caption: Doesn't count steps. Steps count him.
specials.description: A very muscular, ripped black panther with glossy jet-black fur, broad chest and big defined arms. Premium paid edition: thick heavy gold rope chain necklace, small gold hoop earring, black sleeveless compression top, black tapered joggers, black high-top trainers with gold trim. All black and gold, no cream or green clothing. Arms crossed, chin slightly lowered, narrowed gold eyes, quiet dangerous smirk. Very stylish and intimidating.

specials.name: Lone Wolf
specials.outfit: black leather biker jacket over a midnight-blue tank, dark cargo joggers, black boots-style trainers
specials.accessory: silver chain, fingerless gloves, a small scar over one brow
specials.attitude: cool stare, one hand in pocket
specials.caption: Runs alone. Finishes first.
specials.description: A lean, strong silver-grey wolf with a thick neck ruff and a small scar over one brow. Premium paid edition: black leather biker jacket worn open over a midnight-blue tank top, dark cargo joggers, black trainers, fingerless black gloves, a silver chain necklace. No cream or green clothing. Cool, steady, slightly menacing stare, one hand in a pocket. Signature colours midnight blue and silver.

specials.name: Snow Leopard
specials.outfit: ice-white cropped puffer vest, pale grey joggers, white trainers
specials.accessory: ice-blue mirrored ski goggles on the forehead, thin silver chain
specials.caption: Cold start. Hot finish.
specials.description: A sleek snow leopard with smoky white fur, grey rosettes and a very long thick tail. Premium paid edition: ice-white puffer vest, pale grey joggers, white trainers, ice-blue mirrored ski goggles pushed up on the forehead, thin silver chain. No cream or green clothing. Icy, half-lidded, unimpressed confidence. Signature colour ice blue.

specials.name: Tiger
specials.outfit: crimson martial-arts gi with gold embroidery on the lapel
specials.accessory: black belt with frayed ends, red cloth hand wraps
specials.attitude: calm fighter stance, fierce focused eyes
specials.caption: Black belt in not stopping.
specials.description: A powerful Bengal tiger with bold orange and black stripes. Premium paid edition: crimson martial-arts gi with gold embroidered lapels, a worn black belt with frayed ends, red cloth hand wraps, barefoot. No cream or green clothing. Calm, centred fighter stance, fierce focused eyes, the faint smile of someone who already won. Signature colour crimson.

specials.name: Night Owl
specials.outfit: deep purple zip hoodie with the hood down, dark shorts, purple trainers
specials.accessory: gold-rimmed round glasses, small brass pocket watch on a chain
specials.caption: Up at 3 a.m. Still ahead of you.
specials.description: A great horned owl with tall ear tufts and mottled brown feathers, wings used as arms. Premium paid edition: deep purple zip hoodie with the hood down, dark shorts, purple trainers, gold-rimmed round glasses, a small brass pocket watch on a chain clipped to the hoodie. No cream or green clothing. Wide-awake, slightly judging stare. Signature colour violet.

specials.name: Crocodile
specials.outfit: emerald silk bomber jacket, black track pants, white trainers
specials.accessory: one gold tooth, gold signet ring, dark sunglasses
specials.attitude: wide knowing grin, hands behind back
specials.caption: Smiles at the finish line. Bad sign.
specials.description: A bulky Nile crocodile with bumpy olive scales, a long snout and a heavy tail. Premium paid edition: emerald green silk bomber jacket, black track pants, crisp white trainers, dark rectangular sunglasses, a gold signet ring and one gold tooth. Wide, knowing, slightly too friendly grin, hands clasped behind the back. Signature colour emerald.

series.name: Royals
series.blurb: Crowns, capes and very expensive feathers.

specials.name: Lion
specials.outfit: deep red velvet cape with white ermine trim over a gold-and-red track jacket, red shorts, gold trainers
specials.accessory: small tilted gold crown, gold medal on a ribbon
specials.caption: Heavy is the head. Light are the feet.
specials.description: A proud adult lion with a huge golden mane. Premium paid edition: small tilted gold crown, deep red velvet cape with white ermine trim worn over a gold-and-red track jacket, red shorts, gold trainers, a gold medal on a ribbon. No cream or green clothing. Chin up, regal smug half-smile, one hand on hip. Signature colours royal red and gold.

specials.name: Peacock
specials.outfit: sapphire sequin tracksuit, white trainers
specials.accessory: full open tail fan of iridescent feathers, gold aviator sunglasses
specials.attitude: posing, wing on hip, extremely pleased with himself
specials.caption: Dressed to win. Also wins.
specials.description: A vain peacock with an iridescent blue neck and a full open fan of green and blue eye-spot tail feathers behind him, wings used as arms. Premium paid edition: shiny sapphire-blue sequin tracksuit, white trainers, gold aviator sunglasses. No cream or green clothing. Posing with one wing on his hip, extremely pleased with himself. Signature colour sapphire.

specials.name: Flamingo
specials.outfit: hot-pink pleated tennis dress, pink wristbands
specials.accessory: pink feather boa, white heart-shaped sunglasses, pearl stud earrings
specials.attitude: standing on one leg, diva pose
specials.caption: Stands on one leg. Still out-walks you.
specials.description: An elegant pink flamingo with long thin legs and a curved black-tipped beak, wings used as arms. Premium paid edition: hot-pink pleated tennis dress, pink feather boa, white heart-shaped sunglasses, pearl stud earrings, pink wristbands. No cream or green clothing. Diva pose standing on one leg, the other leg tucked up, unbothered. Signature colour hot pink.

specials.name: Persian Cat
specials.outfit: lavender silk tracksuit with pearl buttons, white trainers
specials.accessory: pearl necklace, small diamond tiara
specials.attitude: nose up, pinky raised, deeply unimpressed
specials.caption: Pearls on. Pinky up. Pace up.
specials.description: A very fluffy white Persian cat with a flat face, copper eyes and a huge plume tail. Premium paid edition: lavender silk tracksuit with pearl buttons, a pearl necklace, a small diamond tiara, white trainers. No cream or green clothing. Nose up, pinky raised, aristocratic and deeply unimpressed. Signature colour lavender.

specials.name: Stallion
specials.outfit: navy show-jumping jacket with gold buttons, white breeches, tall polished black riding boots
specials.accessory: gold rosette ribbon pinned to the chest, braided mane
specials.caption: Show jumping? No. Show winning.
specials.description: A tall muscular black horse with a long braided mane and glossy coat. Premium paid edition: tailored navy show-jumping jacket with gold buttons, white breeches, tall polished black riding boots, a big gold first-place rosette pinned to the chest. No cream or green clothing. Proud upright posture, confident smirk. Signature colours navy and gold.

specials.name: Emperor Penguin
specials.outfit: black tailcoat track jacket with silver piping, black shorts
specials.accessory: tiny silver crown, silver medal, bow tie
specials.attitude: waddling with authority, flippers behind back
specials.caption: Waddles with authority.
specials.description: A plump emperor penguin with yellow-orange neck patches, flippers used as arms. Premium paid edition: black tailcoat-style track jacket with silver piping, a silver bow tie, a tiny tilted silver crown, a silver medal. No cream or green clothing. Flippers clasped behind the back, chest out, serious emperor attitude. Signature colour silver.

specials.name: Silverback
specials.outfit: neon-orange stringer tank, black shorts, lifting belt
specials.accessory: sweatband, protein shaker, chalky hands
specials.caption: Skips nothing. Especially not leg day.
specials.description: A huge muscular silverback gorilla with a silver back and broad shoulders. Premium paid edition: neon-orange stringer gym tank, black shorts, a thick black lifting belt, an orange sweatband, chalky hands, holding a protein shaker. No cream or green clothing. Flexing one arm, big proud grin. Signature colour neon orange.

specials.name: Kangaroo
specials.outfit: red satin boxing shorts with a white stripe, white tank
specials.accessory: red boxing gloves, red headgear pushed up, mouthguard in hand
specials.caption: Counts jumps as steps. Nobody argues.
specials.description: A muscular red kangaroo with big feet and a thick tail. Premium paid edition: red satin boxing shorts with a white waistband stripe, white tank, red boxing gloves, red boxing headgear pushed up on the head. No cream or green clothing. Bouncing on its toes, cocky raised eyebrow. Signature colour cherry red.

specials.name: Rhino
specials.outfit: safety-yellow powerlifting singlet, black knee sleeves, flat lifting shoes
specials.accessory: chalk on hands, tiny headphones
specials.caption: Doesn't do warm-ups. Is the warm-up.
specials.description: A massive white rhino with thick grey skin folds and a big horn. Premium paid edition: safety-yellow powerlifting singlet, black knee sleeves, flat lifting shoes, chalk on the hands, small black headphones around the neck. No cream or green clothing. Stoic, immovable, mildly bored. Signature colour safety yellow.

specials.name: Hippo
specials.outfit: electric-purple 80s aerobics leotard over teal leggings, teal leg warmers
specials.accessory: neon headband, chunky wristbands
specials.attitude: mid-step dance energy, huge confident smile
specials.caption: Leg warmers on. Mercy off.
specials.description: A big round hippopotamus with pink-grey skin and tiny ears. Premium paid edition: electric-purple 80s aerobics leotard over teal leggings, teal leg warmers, a neon striped headband, chunky neon wristbands, white high-top aerobics shoes. No cream or green clothing. Full of energy, huge confident smile. Signature colour electric purple.

specials.name: Hamster
specials.outfit: oversized electric-yellow gym hoodie, tiny shorts
specials.accessory: huge over-ear headphones, energy drink can
specials.caption: Small legs. Unreasonable cardio.
specials.description: A tiny round golden hamster with full cheeks. Premium paid edition: oversized electric-yellow gym hoodie with sleeves rolled up, tiny black shorts, huge black over-ear headphones, holding an energy drink can, small white trainers. No cream or green clothing. Wide-eyed, over-caffeinated, ready to sprint. Signature colour electric yellow.

specials.name: Tree Frog
specials.outfit: lime basketball jersey number 00, black shorts, high-top sneakers
specials.accessory: sweatbands on both wrists, a basketball under one arm
specials.caption: Hops count double. Allegedly.
specials.description: A lanky bright green red-eyed tree frog with orange toes. Premium paid edition: lime and black basketball jersey with the number 00, black shorts, black high-top sneakers, sweatbands on both wrists, a basketball under one arm. Cocky trash-talk grin. Signature colour lime.

series.name: Cozy Club
series.blurb: Soft, sleepy, impossible to dislike. Still dangerous on a Sunday.

specials.name: Koala
specials.outfit: oversized sage knit cardigan over pajamas, fluffy slippers
specials.accessory: sleep mask pushed up on the forehead, mug of tea
specials.caption: Twenty hours of sleep. Four of chaos.
specials.description: A chubby grey koala with big fluffy ears and a large dark nose. Premium paid edition: oversized sage knit cardigan over striped pajamas, fluffy slippers, a sleep mask pushed up on the forehead, holding a mug of tea. Barely awake, smug half-closed eyes. Signature colour sage.

specials.name: Panda
specials.outfit: pastel-pink cropped puffer jacket, white joggers, chunky pastel trainers
specials.accessory: bubble tea with a big straw, pink bucket hat
specials.caption: Bubble tea first. Then domination.
specials.description: A round giant panda with black eye patches. Premium paid edition: pastel-pink cropped puffer jacket, white joggers, chunky pastel trainers, a pink bucket hat, holding a bubble tea with a big straw. No cream or green clothing. Sipping calmly, cute but clearly scheming. Signature colour pastel pink.

specials.name: Capybara
specials.outfit: fluffy yuzu-yellow bathrobe, flip-flops
specials.accessory: a small yuzu fruit balanced on the head, towel around the neck
specials.caption: Unbothered. Undefeated.
specials.description: A chunky brown capybara with a blunt square snout. Premium paid edition: fluffy yuzu-yellow spa bathrobe, a white towel around the neck, flip-flops, a small yuzu fruit balanced on its head. No cream or green clothing. Totally unbothered, eyes half closed, zen. Signature colour yuzu yellow.

specials.name: Hedgehog
specials.outfit: rust-orange chunky knit beanie and matching scarf, cozy sweater
specials.accessory: mug of hot cocoa with marshmallows
specials.attitude: grumpy until the cocoa kicks in
specials.caption: Prickly before coffee. Fast after.
specials.description: A small round hedgehog with brown quills and a pointy nose. Premium paid edition: rust-orange chunky knit beanie, matching long scarf, cozy cream-and-rust sweater, holding a steaming mug of hot cocoa with marshmallows. Grumpy face that is about to soften. Signature colour rust.

specials.name: Ginger Cat
specials.outfit: sky-blue cloud-print pajamas, bunny slippers
specials.accessory: bowl of cereal with a spoon, bedhead fur
specials.caption: Woke up at noon. Won by dinner.
specials.description: A chunky ginger tabby cat with bedhead fur. Premium paid edition: sky-blue pajamas with a white cloud print, fuzzy bunny slippers, holding a bowl of cereal with a spoon. No cream or green clothing. Just woke up, sleepy but smug. Signature colour sky blue.

specials.name: Alpaca
specials.outfit: terracotta striped poncho, sandals
specials.accessory: round retro sunglasses, flower behind one ear
specials.caption: Spits on rest days only.
specials.description: A fluffy cream alpaca with a huge pom-pom of wool on its head and a long neck. Premium paid edition: terracotta and mustard striped woven poncho, sandals, round retro sunglasses, a small orange flower behind one ear. No green clothing. Serene, slightly judgmental. Signature colour terracotta.
